scripts.cloud:dev: bunx bun@1.4.2 run --filter @stream-overlay/web build && PORT=${PORT:-3010} bunx bun@1.4.2 --no-orphans apps/server/src/server.ts
scripts.test: bun test && bun run --filter @stream-overlay/web test && bun run --filter @stream-overlay/pokemon-ui test && bun run --filter @stream-overlay/overlay-paint test && bun run --filter @stream-overlay/pokemon-blue test && bun run --filter @stream-overlay/chat test
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter @stream-overlay/local typecheck && bun run --filter @stream-overlay/web typecheck && bun run --filter @stream-overlay/server typecheck && bun run --filter @stream-overlay/pokemon-ui typecheck && bun run --filter @stream-overlay/pokemon-blue typecheck && bun run --filter @stream-overlay/pokemon-crystal typecheck && bun run --filter @stream-overlay/overlay-paint typecheck && bun run --filter @stream-overlay/chat typecheck && bun run --filter @stream-overlay/emoticons typecheck
scripts.build: bun run --filter @stream-overlay/web build && bun run --filter @stream-overlay/pokemon-blue build && bun run --filter @stream-overlay/pokemon-crystal build && bun run --filter @stream-overlay/chat build && bun build apps/local/src/server.ts --target bun --outdir dist/local && bun build apps/server/src/server.ts --target bun --outdir dist/server
